scenario: the first practical exchange about messages & everyday digital communication
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Messages and Everyday Digital Communication
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: messages & everyday digital communication — the first practical exchange about messages & everyday digital communication
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about messages & everyday digital communication; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Olivia tells Ms Lan she has a message for her.
context_note_vi: Chị Olivia báo cho chị Lan biết có tin nhắn cho chị.

turns.speaker: Ms Olivia
turns.english: Lan, please check your phone. I have a message for you.
turns.vietnamese: Lan ơi, chị xem điện thoại giúp tôi với. Tôi có nhắn tin cho chị đó.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Just a moment. Yes, I see it now.
turns.vietnamese: Chờ một chút. Vâng, tôi thấy rồi.

turns.speaker: Ms Olivia
turns.vietnamese: Tốt rồi. Cảm ơn chị đã xem.
